[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/QgZsM7L.png[/img]﻿
﻿[/center][center]﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/RPtBZPi.png[/img][/center][left][/left][center][left][/left]By popular demand I decided to make a map that is made to go with Soft Slow Seasons and Overgrown Flowery Interface. But it will work with all terrain retextures as it just does the world maps. They are seasonal but only the leaves in the corners change.

Please do not ask for any variations or changes to the maps, I made these for personal use so if you do not like the look then you don't have to use it.

If there are any issues or you would like a mod's map patched please let me know![/center]
